name: E2_ctx8_noise10_rand3000_gap0.5_hard0_augnone (run 0)
about: FruitPunch AI rumble classifier, improved and retrained by Amogh Shetty (Elephant Listening Project, 2026). AVES embeddings of audio resampled to 500 Hz, then a classifier that looks at 17 neighbouring 0.64 s frames (about 11 s).
cut_off_note: Detections scoring at least 0.993 are kept: on the validation days this found 80% of the rumbles.
